About ENDAT

ENDAT Automation Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru company founded in April 2022. We combine two kinds of work under one roof: engineering for the machines that make products, and digital systems for the businesses that sell and support them.

On the industrial side we program PLCs, HMIs and SCADA, commission and retrofit CNC machines, and design electrical control panels. On the digital side we build AI call agents, WhatsApp automation, websites, web and mobile apps, dashboards, and management systems for clinics and educational institutes.

Every project starts with your application. We study the machine or the process first, then choose the simplest system that does the job reliably and that your team can maintain.

  • Based in BengaluruServing manufacturers and businesses across India.
  • Founded April 2022Industrial engineering and digital automation under one company.
  • Two divisionsIndustrial Engineering, and AI & Digital Automation.
  • Support after go-liveCommissioning, training and ongoing support.

We start with your application, then engineer what needs to work.

Frequently asked questions

Straight answers about our services and how we work.

What does ENDAT Automation Solutions do?

ENDAT has two divisions. Industrial Engineering covers PLC, HMI and SCADA programming, CNC solutions, machine retrofit, electrical control panels and troubleshooting. AI & Digital Automation covers AI call agents, WhatsApp automation, websites, web and mobile apps, dashboards, digital marketing, and patient and student management systems.

What is machine retrofitment and when is it worth it?

Retrofitment replaces the old controls, drives, HMI or electrical panel on a machine that is mechanically sound, so it runs reliably again without buying a new machine. It is usually worth considering when spare parts for the old control are no longer available or the machine keeps stopping because of its electronics.

Can you work on CNC machines with different controllers?

We support CNC programming, commissioning, fault analysis, parameter support, and servo and spindle drive work. Tell us the machine make and controller when you contact us and we will confirm what we can do.

How does an AI call agent work for a clinic or business?

The agent answers incoming calls, understands the caller’s request, collects details such as name and phone number, and can book an appointment or pass the enquiry to your team. Outgoing reminder and follow-up calls can be set up as well.

What can WhatsApp automation do?

It can answer common questions, capture leads, guide customers through choices, share documents, send appointment and payment reminders, and route enquiries to the right person on your team.

Do you build patient management and student management systems?

Yes. The patient system covers registration, appointments, visit history, billing and reports for hospitals and clinics. The student system covers admissions, records, attendance, fees and parent communication for educational institutes.

How much does a project cost?

Cost depends on the machine, the scope of work and the systems involved, so we do not publish fixed prices. Send us your requirement on WhatsApp or through the form and we will reply with next steps.

How do I get started?

Message us on WhatsApp at +91 81235 97853, call +91 86605 86938 or +91 98807 76008, or use the form on this page. Describe the machine, process or business need and an ENDAT engineer will reply.

Do you support customers outside Bengaluru?

Yes. We are based in Bengaluru and work with customers across India. Remote support is possible for programming, fault analysis and digital projects, and site visits can be arranged for commissioning.

Which PLC brands do you work with?

Our service lists Siemens, Mitsubishi and other PLC platforms. If you use a different brand, tell us the model and we will confirm before you commit.

Can I automate my clinic or school without changing how we work today?

Yes. We start from your current process, such as how appointments, admissions or fees are handled today, and build the system around it so staff do not have to learn a completely new way of working.

Do you also run Meta and Instagram ads?

Yes. Our digital marketing service covers Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads, Instagram page management, lead generation campaigns, landing pages and performance reports.
